verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the splashdown location as Pacific Ocean off San Diego coast.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET (0007 GMT April 11).

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm exact date, day (Friday implied by context), time in ET/EDT, matching UTC conversion.
